description: Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-15 recorded by spottingmode as preserved with the serial 03 near a monument roundabout in the Khormaksar district close to Aden International Airport. The record dates from March 2013, before the 2015 battle for Aden airport was fought across this ground. The only Esri imagery available for the point is from 29 December 2019 and shows a small pale object at the location that cannot be positively confirmed as an aircraft. Existed in 2013; current state unconfirmed. TAIL NUMBER DELIBERATELY BLANK: the airframe wears 03 and that is not in doubt, but the database enforces a unique key on model plus tail number and a Soviet MiG-15UTI also numbered 03 is already recorded at Monino. The number is preserved in the aliases.
